label: dashScalesWithWidth: the dashed pattern isn't scaled by the width, so a 4 pt line gets 1 pt dashes
hairlineDashVisible: min for max(width, 1), so a hairline's dashes shrink below 1 pt
widthsClamp: the width's upper limit is dropped, so 2000 pt stays 2000
trimThenDash: the path is dashed before it is trimmed, so a trim cuts the dashes' length instead of the outline's
startEqualToEndPaintsNothing: a trim whose start equals its end paints the whole outline
find: guard trim.start != trim.end else { return Path(elements: []) }
replace: guard trim.start != trim.end else { return path }

label: dashReadsThePhase: dash(of:) drops the stored phase, so a custom phase reads back as 0
validPattern: an all-zero pattern passes, so stroke.dash saves a pattern FlareCore refuses to dash
